ratenet_architecture_inspection.governing_equation: x = ext[i] + (sensory[i] ? 0 : inp[i]) - theta[i] * (1 + aK * Ai / rmax[i])
ratenet_architecture_inspection.activation_equation: act = m * Math.tanh(a[i] / m * x) if x > 0 else 0

available_pre_threshold_variables.name: net.inp[i]
available_pre_threshold_variables.physical_meaning: Instantaneous total synaptic input current arrived from all presynaptic partners
available_pre_threshold_variables.subthreshold_behavior: Nonzero and actively integrating synaptic drive even when somatic firing r[i] == 0

available_pre_threshold_variables.name: net.theta[i]
available_pre_threshold_variables.physical_meaning: Intrinsic somatic firing threshold (derived from neuron volume / biophysical parameters)
available_pre_threshold_variables.subthreshold_behavior: Static biophysical parameter against which synaptic input is integrated

available_pre_threshold_variables.name: x_i = ext[i] + inp[i] - theta_i * (1 + adapt)
available_pre_threshold_variables.physical_meaning: Net somatic membrane drive relative to threshold. When x <= 0, neuron is subthreshold.
available_pre_threshold_variables.subthreshold_behavior: Quantifies exactly how close the neuron is to crossing threshold.

available_pre_threshold_variables.name: normalized_dendritic_drive = max(0, inp[i] / theta[i])
available_pre_threshold_variables.physical_meaning: Fraction of threshold covered by dendritic synaptic convergence
available_pre_threshold_variables.subthreshold_behavior: Smoothly varies in [0, 1] as synapses become active, without requiring spike emission.

AN03A008.interpretation: AN03A008 receives substantial synaptic input (inp=87.1), but threshold (theta=50.7) and high adaptation suppress sustained rate.

DNa02.interpretation: DNa02 receives initial input (inp=7.6 to 117.5), which is well below motor threshold (theta=143.2). Soma remains completely silent (r=0.0 Hz), but dendritic arbor receives clear synaptic drive.

biophysical_justification.biological_analogue: NMDA receptor magnesium unblock depends on local postsynaptic dendritic depolarization, not somatic action potential backpropagation alone. Subthreshold EPSPs depolarize the local post-synaptic dendritic spine sufficiently to relieve Mg2+ block, priming synaptic plasticity even if the soma has not yet crossed threshold to fire an action potential.
biophysical_justification.rate_model_equivalent: In RateNetwork, net.inp[target] represents the exact summed dendritic synaptic input. Using subthreshold postsynaptic drive allows silent but structurally present pathways to accumulate eligibility upon presynaptic drive and receive reinforcement.
